prompts.roll:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production Neo Geo quality hand-drawn sprite animation, transparent PNG. Reference is the actual orange enemy stealth fighter from our game: rigid angular wings, long center cockpit/nose, two rear nacelles, orange metal panels. Create precisely SIXTEEN sequential views of this SAME rigid aircraft executing ONE complete axial barrel roll in 22.5 degree increments. Exact layout 4 columns x 4 rows equal 256x256 slots, whole sheet 1024x1024, no labels, no outlines between cells. Read left-to-right then down. The aircraft's longitudinal axis stays vertical, nose points SOUTH/down in every view, fixed physical center and same overall fore-aft length and camera scale in each slot. Frame angles: 0,22.5,45,67.5;90,112.5,135,157.5;180,202.5,225,247.5;270,292.5,315,337.5. Show true rigid three-dimensional turning: at 0 top/cockpit,90 right edge-on with the aircraft's sidewall,180 BOTTOM/belly with intake/gear panels and no top cockpit,270 left edge-on sidewall,then return to top. Wings and tail actually occlude one another in edge views; their foreshortening comes from viewing real rigid geometry. Absolutely no bent wings, no stretched/flared/squashed copy of the top sprite, no 2D spin, no banking while still showing the top. Two wings, two engines, consistent hardware and mass, identical orange palette and crisp detailed pixel-art linework to seed. Every frame's rigid body center precisely at slot128,128; nose/tail centered on that axis. Maximum top-view length208 and width200, safe transparent margins all around. Produce all16 poses in ONE sheet.
Additional orange variant hardware constraint: reference2 is the existing orange heavy fighter with TWO independently mounted dual-barrel Gatling pods at the wings (FOUR barrels total). Carry those two same pods through every rigid view with correct occlusion. The primary reference blue stealth fighter supplies the correct central hull/wing/nacelle identity; recolor its metal trim orange, preserve neutral silver/charcoal metal and add the second reference's two Gatling mounts. Do not borrow the second reference's different silver hull silhouette. The actual pod barrels turn with the rigid aircraft, not a pasted overlay. No extra gun pods.
